shortDescription: NetApp ONTAP local user account restrictions

options.name: account_expiry_time
options.description: Specifies account expiration in days. The default setting is -1 (unlimited), which means the accounts never expire. The account expiry time must be greater than account inactive limit.

options.name: account_inactive_limit
options.description: Specifies inactive account expiry limit in days. The default setting is -1 (unlimited), which means the inactive accounts never expire.

options.name: account_lockout_duration
options.description: Specifies the duration in ISO 8601 format (P[<int>D]T[<int>H][<int>M][<int>S]) for which an account is locked if the failed login attempts reach the allowed maximum. The default is 1 hour.

options.name: cert_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client cert file (.pem). not supported with python 2.6.

options.name: change_delay
options.description: Specifies the number of days that must pass between password changes. The default setting is 0.

options.name: delay_after_failed_login
options.description: Specifies the amount of delay observed by the system in seconds upon invalid login attempts. The default setting is 4 seconds.

options.name: disallowed_reuse
options.description: Specifies the number of previous passwords that are disallowed for reuse. The default setting is 6. The minimum allowed value is 6.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: force_ontap_version
options.description: Override the cluster ONTAP version when using REST. The behavior is undefined if the version does not match the target cluster. This is provided as a work-around when the cluster version cannot be read because of permission issues. See https://github.com/ansible-collections/netapp.ontap/wiki/Known-issues. This should be in the form 9.10 or 9.10.1 with each element being an integer number.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the ONTAP instance.

options.name: http_port
options.description: Override the default port (80 or 443) with this port

options.name: https
options.description: Enable and disable https. Ignored when using REST as only https is supported. Ignored when using SSL certificate authentication as it requires SSL.

options.name: key_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client key file.

options.name: max_failed_login_attempts
options.description: Specifies the allowed maximum number of consecutive invalid login attempts. When the failed login attempts reach the specified maximum, the account is automatically locked. The default is 5.

options.name: passwd_alphanum
options.description: If this parameter is enabled, a password must contain at least one letter and one number. The default setting is enabled.

options.name: passwd_expiry_time
options.description: Specifies password expiration in days. A value of 0 means all passwords associated with the accounts in the role expire now. The default setting is -1 (unlimited), which means the passwords never expire.

options.name: passwd_expiry_warn_time
options.description: Specifies the warning period for password expiry in days. A value of 0 means warn user about password expiry upon every successful login. The default setting is -1 (unlimited), which means never warn about password expiry.

options.name: passwd_min_digits
options.description: Specifies the minimum number of digits required in a password. The default setting is 0.

options.name: passwd_min_lowercase_chars
options.description: Specifies the minimum number of lowercase characters required in a password. The default setting is 0.

options.name: passwd_min_special_chars
options.description: Specifies the minimum number of special characters required in a password. Supported values are from 0 to 127 special characters. The default setting is 0.

options.name: passwd_min_uppercase_chars
options.description: Specifies the minimum number of uppercase characters required in a password. The default setting is 0.

options.name: passwd_minlength
options.description: Specifies the required minimum length of a password. Supported values are 3 to 127 characters. The default setting is 8 characters.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the specified user.

options.name: require_initial_passwd_update
options.description: Specifies whether users must change their passwords when logging in for the first time. The default setting is disabled.

options.name: role
options.description: Specifies the role whose account restrictions are to be modified.

options.name: state
options.description: Configure local user account restrictions, only present is supported.

options.name: use_lambda
options.description: Specifies if AWS Lambda proxy functionality should be used to connect to the ONTAP system. Supported only with REST.

options.name: use_rest
options.description: This module only supports REST. always -- will always use the REST API. A warning is issued if the module does not support REST.

options.name: username
options.description: This can be a Cluster-scoped or SVM-scoped account, depending on whether a Cluster-level or SVM-level API is required. For more information, please read the documentation U(https://docs.netapp.com/us-en/ontap/authentication/create-svm-user-accounts-task.html). Two authentication methods are supported 1. Basic authentication, using username and password. 2. SSL certificate authentication, using a ssl client cert file, and optionally a private key file. To use a certificate, the certificate must h

options.name: username_alphanum
options.description: If this parameter is enabled, a user name must contain at least one letter and one number. The default setting is disabled.

options.name: username_minlength
options.description: Specifies the required minimum length of the user name. Supported values are 3 to 32 characters. The default setting is 3 characters.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(False) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vserver
options.description: Specifies the SVM name associated with the profile configuration.
